name: Other Payment 6
definition: Payment related to elements not reported in dedicated fields.

PaymentCurrency.name: Payment Currency
PaymentCurrency.definition: Currency of payment the reporting counterparty made or received.

PaymentType.name: Payment Type
PaymentType.definition: Indicates the type of other payment.

PaymentDate.name: Payment Date
PaymentDate.definition: Indicates the unadjusted date on which the other payment is paid.

PaymentPayer.name: Payment Payer
PaymentPayer.definition: Identifies the payer of the other payment amount.

PaymentReceiver.name: Payment Receiver
PaymentReceiver.definition: Identifies the receiver of the other payment amount.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
